scripts/binary_signing.py

Python · Tier B

Sign native images and release executables using configured platform identities.

Usage

Called by the builder; absent signing configuration leaves artifacts unsigned.

Inputs

Target, image/artifact paths, relocation list and SMTO_MACOS/SMTO_WINDOWS signing settings.

Side effects

Invokes platform signing/verification tools and optional macOS notarization. Signing keys stay in platform stores; relocation-bound wrappers are excluded from image signing.

Cleanup

Temporary notarization ZIPs are scoped locally; signed release outputs remain caller-owned.
